svg.title: Steady-state temperature field of the heatflow plate
svg.desc: Contour map of a 1 by 0.5 plate whose top edge is held at 100 sin(pi x) degrees and whose other edges are at 0. The 20, 40, 60 and 80 degree contours are arches that rise toward the middle of the top edge, which is the hottest point.
svg.text: Steady temperature of the plate (contours every 20 degrees)
